title: UPI se payment karte waqt peeche kya hota hai?
hooks: Google Pay ya PhonePe aapka ek rupya bhi transfer nahi karte.
Aapka UPI app aapka paisa kabhi haath bhi nahi lagata.
PIN daala aur do second mein payment done... par beech mein paisa kahan gaya?
hook_why: Contrarian hook that immediately shatters user assumption that payment apps move the actual money, driving high watch retention.
metaphor: NPCI ek central air traffic controller hai jo bina paisa chuve do alag banks ke beech transaction route karta hai.

scenes.vo: Google Pay ya PhonePe aapka ek rupya bhi transfer nahi karte.

scenes.vo: Kya aapko lagta tha PhonePe paise bhejta hai? Comment mein sach batao!

caption: PhonePe aur Google Pay aapka ek rupya bhi transfer nahi karte! Dekhiye kaise NPCI aur aapka bank sirf 2 second mein poora settlement karte hain. Kya aapko yeh pata tha?

claims.claim: Third-party UPI apps (Google Pay, PhonePe) do not hold customer deposits or directly transfer money; settlement occurs bank-to-bank.
claims.basis: NPCI Unified Payments Interface framework: TPAPs operate as front-end application providers on top of sponsor and member Core Banking Systems.

claims.claim: The encrypted transaction request routes via the NPCI switch to verify credentials with the remitter bank CBS before notifying the beneficiary bank.
claims.basis: NPCI UPI Operating Guidelines and core transaction routing flows.
